title: Usage, Credits & Cost Reconciliation

surfaces.app_credit_separation: ApplicationCreditBalance -> AccountCenterAiUsageReport.applicationCreditsRemaining (never a provider cost bucket) + RightRailCredits

defects_found_and_fixed.measured_fact: costIsExact returned true for a live, complete, reported two-currency report (costTotals=[USD=1.0, IDR=900.0], freshnessCounts={live: 2}); uiState then reported CONNECTED because it tested costTotals.every(subtotal != null) directly instead of the exactness contract.
defects_found_and_fixed.root_cause: costIsExact never checked the currency count, and uiState bypassed costIsExact entirely.
defects_found_and_fixed.fix: costIsExact now refuses more than one currency bucket; uiState follows costIsExact.
defects_found_and_fixed.necessity_proof: removing 'if (costTotals.length > 1) return false;' -> rc=1, exactly one failing test

defects_found_and_fixed.measured_fact: providerApi, localLog, and userDeclared rows produced byte-identical costText ('Reported 0.5 USD') and byte-identical textSummary; a user-declared figure was indistinguishable from a metered provider measurement. A user-declared row also kept costIsExact=true.
defects_found_and_fixed.root_cause: costLabel read only the isEstimate flag and never the row's source; the summary never named a non-provider source.
defects_found_and_fixed.fix: originLabel/sourcePhrase/isProviderReported added; costLabel follows the row's origin first; the summary names every non-provider source; costIsExact requires isProviderReported.
defects_found_and_fixed.necessity_proof: removing the originLabel getter -> rc=1 (compile-level refusal of the label); removing the period-mismatch note -> rc=1

defects_found_and_fixed.measured_fact: A record billed to 2026-09 but measured 2026-10-20 was summed in full into the 2026-09 bar and total with costIsExact=true and no disclosure anywhere: textSummary never mentioned 2026-10, unknownFilterValues was empty, emptyReason was null, and suggestedAction blamed freshness instead.
defects_found_and_fixed.root_cause: The period axis is built from billing_period alone; nothing compared billing_period against measuredAt.
defects_found_and_fixed.fix: AiUsageRow.billingPeriodMismatches plus report.periodMismatchCount; costIsExact refuses any mismatch; the summary discloses the billed/measured month pair.
defects_found_and_fixed.necessity_proof: removing 'if (periodMismatchCount > 0) return false;' -> rc=1, exactly one failing test; removing the disclosure clause -> rc=1, exactly one failing test

defects_found_and_fixed.measured_fact: An application credit balance measured 2020-01-01 was rendered as the plain number 'Application credits: 5.' with no freshness applied, while provider rows in the same report were aged against the clock.
defects_found_and_fixed.root_cause: The balance carried no freshness classification and the summary formatted the raw double.
defects_found_and_fixed.fix: applicationCreditsFreshness/applicationCreditsIsCurrent/creditsText classify the balance with the same AiUsageFreshnessPolicy used for rows; a non-live balance prints 'unavailable (stale|expired)'.
defects_found_and_fixed.necessity_proof: removing the 'unavailable (${freshness.name})' clause -> rc=1, exactly one failing test

harness_defects_corrected_before_claimin: the four probe files each failed to compile on first run (a declaration inside a set literal, a nullable DateTime dereference, and AiUsageChartSeries.buckets which does not exist); all three were harness faults, corrected before any defect claim

costLabel was first made to return originLabel unconditionally, which broke the pre-existing 115.40 pin 'a provider row with isEstimate=true reads Estimated' (Expected 'Estimated', Actual 'Reported'); the label now checks the origin first and the estimate flag second, and that pin is green again
the first necessity run used LF markers against a CRLF file and matched nothing; the run was rewritten to strip lines by regex with DOTALL

necessity_proof.method: each fix block removed one at a time from the shipped file, the slice gate re-run, then the file restored from in-memory bytes and re-verified by SHA-256
necessity_proof.result_per_block: rc=1 with exactly one failing test each
necessity_proof.restore_verified: byte-identical, SHA-256 725be741d84300a9... and a final green run rc=0

gates.format: pass1 changed 2 files, pass2 0 changed, exit 0 (idempotent)

windows_evidence.caveat: the build is NOT slice evidence. A positive-control type error in lib/main.dart failed the build (exit 1, error G44692867), proving the Dart kernel really is recompiled, while the same type error in the slice file still exited 0 because lib/features/account/domain/ is not reachable from main.dart. An earlier poison attempt using an unused throwing function was discarded as a harness fault: tree-shaking removes an unreferenced function, so it proved nothing either way. The build therefore proves no regression on the reachable program only, not on this slice.
windows_evidence.poison_residue: none; both poisoned files restored and verified byte-identical against HEAD

preserved_untouched: 13 scratch probe files from runs 117.9 and 117.23-117.25
